buildCommand: echo "export const environment = { production: false, supabaseUrl: '${SUPABASE_URL}', supabaseKey: '${SUPABASE_KEY}' };" > src/environments/environment.ts && echo "export const environment = { production: true, supabaseUrl: '${SUPABASE_URL}', supabaseKey: '${SUPABASE_KEY}' };" > src/environments/environment.prod.ts && ng build --configuration production
